//: Self-contained check that the drawn pointer matches the real one — no app, no network, no account. It loads an inline page with a link, a button and a text field, and takes the cursor across all three so the recording shows the pointer CHANGE shape: arrow over the page, hand over the link and the button, text bar over the field.
//why: DemoTape draws its own enlarged pointer, so the shape has to be sampled from the system rather than assumed. Watch the recording for three things: the hand appears over the link and the button with its FINGERTIP on the target (not offset, not clipped), the I-beam appears over the field, and the arrow returns over plain page. Then check the recording's .source/*.events.json: `cursor` samples should carry more than one distinct `k` value.
